periods.description: --- 变量输出格式: rule: - you should output the update analysis and the actual update commands at the very end of the assistant reply - the update commands must strictly follow JSON Patch RFC 6902 - only use replace, add, remove - when adding a new character to 关系网, always use path "/关系网/-" - never use "/关系网/角色名" as the path - if updating an existing character in 关系网, use the correct array index path such as "/关系网/0/好感度" - output at most 5 patch operations each time - only update variables that actually changed in the current assistant reply - the UpdateVariable block must be outside code fences - the UpdateVariable block must not be explained as plain text - the UpdateVariable block must be the final content of the assistant reply format: |- <UpdateVariable> <Analysis>$(IN ENGLISH, no more than 80 words) - calculate time passed - decide whether dramatic updates are allowed - analyze each variable based only on the current assistant reply </Analysis> <JSONPatch> [ { "op": "add", "path": "/关系网/-", "value": {"角色名":"飞鸟","好感度":5,"信任度":5,"关系":"初识","所属阵营":"国立半藏学院"} }, { "op": "replace", "path": "/阵营立场/国立半藏学院", "value": 5 } ] </JSONPatch> </UpdateVariable>
